profile.headline: Cloud & AI Software Engineer | Lead System Architect | Vertex AI Specialist | 31x GCP Badges
profile.bio: I am a Full-Stack Software Engineer & Lead System Architect based in Dubai, specializing in the MERN stack (React.js, Node.js, MongoDB), Django REST Framework, scalable Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure, cloud networking & security, applied AI integration, and high-concurrency enterprise financial systems. Backed by a BTech in Computer Engineering, 31x Google Cloud badges, 206+ completed GCP labs, and memberships in GDG Dubai and GDG Cloud Emirates.

experience.impact: Engineered enterprise financial platform managing >1M AED cash vaults across 2 branches and 5 collection agents.

projects.title: Ferrari Foods LLC Enterprise Financial & Cash Vault Operations System
projects.problem: Need for real-time tracking of multi-branch corporate cash vaults (>1M AED), field agent collection sessions, and PDF LR form generation.
projects.solution: Built RBAC financial control panel tracking >1M AED across Accountant, CEO, Bank, and Petty Cash vaults with note denomination breakdown (1000, 500, 200, 100 AED notes) for 2 branches and 5 collection agents on GCP backend VM.

projects.title: Enterprise Multimodal WhatsApp AI Assistant & Cross-Project Ledger Engine
projects.problem: Manual console searching to correct multi-collection ledger entries and physical currency note inventory caused admin friction.
projects.solution: Built an event-driven cross-cloud IAM service account architecture using TypeScript, Node 20, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Firebase Admin SDK executing atomic 5-collection Firestore batch deletions, outbox queueing, and non-repudiation audit logging.

projects.title: GCP Cloud Run Serverless Cost Optimization Case Study (90% Reduction)
projects.problem: Running low-traffic Node.js backends on always-on Compute Engine VMs generated unnecessary 24/7 idle server charges ($17.92/mo).
projects.solution: Containerized backend and migrated to GCP Cloud Run serverless, scaling to zero when idle and paying per request ($1.40/mo).

projects.title: Production Backend Migration (Serverless GCP Cloud Run to Dedicated VM)
projects.problem: Serverless Cloud Run CPU billing spikes, 24/7 WebSocket drops (disconnect 409), and frozen 08:00 AM cron tasks.
projects.solution: Migrated backend to dedicated GCP Compute Engine VM (e2-medium) + Caddy Reverse Proxy (Auto-SSL) with 4-stage zero-downtime rollback pipeline.

projects.title: MenuSent On-the-Fly Image Delivery Network & Cloud CDN Optimization
projects.problem: 5MB raw menu images caused 8-second load delays on Dubai 3G networks.
projects.solution: Deployed GCP Cloud Run microservice (Node.js + Sharp) behind Google Global Load Balancer & Cloud CDN, dynamically shrinking assets to 30KB WebP files cached at edge nodes.

projects.title: MenuSent Cloud-to-Kitchen Thermal Printer Hardware Integration
projects.problem: Order confirmation latency caused kitchen ticket delays during dinner rushes.
projects.solution: Built direct cloud triggers for Wi-Fi (static IP) and Bluetooth thermal printers with user-defined configuration in MenuSent admin panel.

projects.title: Enterprise Dual-Write AI Document Ingestion Pipeline
projects.problem: Separating operational data from analytical data without speed sacrifice.
projects.solution: Dual-Write architecture using Vertex AI Gemini 2.5, React HITL ground-truth verification, and Promise.all backend streaming to Google Sheets and BigQuery.

projects.title: AI Invoice Ingestion Pipeline with Sharp Compression & Confidence Scoring
projects.problem: 3MB+ mobile invoice photos spiked GCS costs; LLMs risk hallucinating accounting figures.
projects.solution: Node.js Sharp pre-processing compressing/grayscale-converting invoice photos before GCS vaulting; Gemini 2.5 confidence score validation.

projects.title: CloudDrive SaaS – Secure File Management & Metadata Sharing (Phases 1 & 2)
projects.problem: File duplication and high delay during account-to-account workspace transfers.
projects.solution: User-isolated GCS buckets, password hashing, storage quota tracking, metadata-based zero-duplication transfer, link expiry, and API rate limiting.

projects.title: 24x7 Cloud WireGuard VPN Server Infrastructure
projects.problem: Need for secure, encrypted 24x7 cloud networking tunnel.
projects.solution: Deployed Ubuntu 24.04 VM on GCP (Mumbai region) with WireGuard VPN, static IP, custom firewall rules (UDP 51820), NAT, and handshake verification.

projects.title: n8n AI Agent WhatsApp Assistant via Twilio & Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite
projects.problem: Unstructured WhatsApp message parsing; free-tier API rate limits and conversational fluff.
projects.solution: Built n8n AI Agent using Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite on Google AI Studio Paid Tier 1 (10k req/day) with strict markdown system prompt rules.

projects.title: Windows-to-Linux Cloud Build & Cloud Run Troubleshooting
projects.problem: Windows → Linux permission differences causing Docker build failures, Cloud Build `tsc` permission denied.
projects.solution: Enforced clean Docker builds with `.dockerignore`, switched to `npx tsc`, and moved secrets to Cloud Run env variables.
